title: NieR:Automata
alternative_titles: ニーア オートマタ
description: Androids 2B, 9S, and A2 fight machine lifeforms on a ruined Earth in an action RPG combining close-range weapon combat, ranged Pod attacks, and hacking with a story about the conflict between androids and machines.

player_sentiment.summary: Across two sampled player discussions, participants praise the soundtrack, emotional storytelling, and unusual narrative perspectives; others find repeated sections, fetch quests, or hacking tedious and combat too simple, with disagreement about whether the eventual story payoff outweighs that repetition. This is a limited qualitative sample, not a representative consensus.
positives: Fluid combat and genre variety appeal to some players
negatives: Repeated sections can feel tedious before the story payoff
Fetch-style side quests feel repetitive to some players
Combat simplicity and repeated hacking divide players
